A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a robust, efficient, and scalable protocol that generates OPCs from hPSCs in ~20 d.

this protocol provides the first robust method to generate OLs from hPSCs in only 20 d and that these OPCs can be cryopreserved and used to establish an all-human myelin platform for the study of MS and ALS.
this method provides an all-human myelin platform that can be used to screen pro-myelinating drugs and to study OLs from patient-specific cells in vitro and in animal models.

the protocol is robust, efficient, and can be applied to any hPSC line, including those derived from MS and ALS patients.
hPSC-derived OPCs are an excellent tool for modeling human disease and testing novel therapeutics for demyelinating diseases such as MS.
